scope: mappa colonne -> famiglia, grandezze derivate, mappa famiglia -> meccanismo, S_F e controlli per E5 (piano §8.12)

raw_std_ratio.role: dispersione complessiva; alimenta solo il blocco `dispersion` e l'ultima frase del testo neutrale
raw_std_ratio.rule: non appartiene a nessuna famiglia ablata: non si permuta mai e non si omette mai. Va dichiarato: una quota del testo resta invariata in ogni braccio.

window_start_h/window_end_h/variable.role: geometria della finestra e identita della XMEAS
window_start_h/window_end_h/variable.rule: invarianti per costruzione in ogni braccio

rapid_variability.perm_rule: ricalcolata a valle dai valori effettivamente presenti nel braccio (E5-B)
rapid_variability.omit_rule: non computabile: cade con il genitore omesso

coherent_drift_episodes.formula: run di finestre con trend attivo, segno della pendenza costante e shift_sigma monotono nello stesso segno (_coherent_drift_runs)
coherent_drift_episodes.perm_rule: ricalcolata; una permutazione di `level` o di `trend` la modifica
coherent_drift_episodes.note: grandezza derivata inter-famiglia NON nominata in §8.12: va dichiarata nel protocollo E5 accanto a `rapid`

strict_global_drift.formula: strict_global_persistence(trend) AND un solo episodio di drift coerente esteso a tutte le finestre

settling_transient.formula: residual attiva nella fase iniziale, ne residual ne diff attive nella fase finale, mediana residual iniziale > finale
settling_transient.note: seconda grandezza derivata inter-famiglia non nominata in §8.12

phase_values.formula: mediane e conteggi di attivazione di residual e diff per fase (initial/intermediate/late)
phase_values.omit_rule: la quota relativa al genitore omesso cade

mechanism_map_proposal.status: PROPOSTA DELL'AUTORE DA CONFERMARE (decisione C) - assegnata a priori da Downs & Vogel 1993 §12.4, cieca alle attivazioni osservate

step.rationale: un gradino sposta il livello medio e lo mantiene

random variation.rationale: variazione casuale attorno al set point: aumento della dispersione senza spostamento della media ne pendenza

slow drift.rationale: deriva lenta e monotona della cinetica

sticking valve.rationale: valvola che si blocca e si libera: salti campione-campione e discontinuita

level.rationale: il gradino e il meccanismo che sposta il livello; il controllo e scelto fra i meccanismi che a priori NON agiscono sul livello medio
level.assignment_is_a_priori: the mechanism comes from the Type column of Table 8; the pairing family<->mechanism is the author's, argued from the description of the mechanism, never from which descriptors activate in our data (development included)

trend.rationale: la pendenza descrive la deriva; il gradino e il controllo perche sposta il livello senza pendenza sostenuta
trend.assignment_is_a_priori: the mechanism comes from the Type column of Table 8; the pairing family<->mechanism is the author's, argued from the description of the mechanism, never from which descriptors activate in our data (development included)

residual.rationale: Table 8 Type = 'Random variation' for IDV(8) and IDV(10): the source describes a disturbance that varies at random around the operating point, with no imposed shift or ramp. What such a disturbance leaves in the signal, after the linear trend is removed, is residual dispersion: that is exactly what residual_std_ratio measures. Control = step, deterministic and with no persistent random component.
residual.assignment_is_a_priori: the mechanism comes from the Type column of Table 8; the pairing family<->mechanism is the author's, argued from the description of the mechanism, never from which descriptors activate in our data (development included)

diff.rationale: Table 8 Type = 'Sticking' for IDV(14) and IDV(15), on a cooling-water valve: a valve that sticks and releases moves the manipulated variable in discrete jumps, repeatedly. A jump between consecutive samples is what diff_std_ratio measures, and the repetition is what distinguishes it from the single discontinuity of a step, which is the control.
diff.assignment_is_a_priori: the mechanism comes from the Type column of Table 8; the pairing family<->mechanism is the author's, argued from the description of the mechanism, never from which descriptors activate in our data (development included)

mechanism_map_proposal.warning: residual <-> random variation and diff <-> sticking are NOT obvious. The mechanism labels are verifiable in Table 8; the pairing with a descriptor family is an argument, and it must be frozen before any activation is looked at. It is decision C and it needs the author's signature.

bibliographic_source.citation: Downs, J.J. & Vogel, E.F. (1993), "A plant-wide industrial process control problem", Computers & Chemical Engineering 17(3), 245-255, DOI 10.1016/0098-1354(93)80018-I
bibliographic_source.passage: Table 8, p. 250, "Process disturbances": the column "Type" assigns a mechanism to each IDV(1)-IDV(20). That column, and only that column, is the source of the mechanism; nothing here is inferred from the observed signature.
bibliographic_source.note_p_251: On p. 251 the same source recommends using disturbances IDV(14)-IDV(20) together with a further disturbance or a setpoint change; the run specification declares its deviation from that recommendation (studio2/fase03/fault_runs/SPECIFICA_RUN_FAULT.md 2) and F14/F15 are studied as single faults. The deviation concerns the generation of the runs, not the mechanism label.

per_fault_type_column.F1 = IDV(1): Step - A/C feed ratio, B composition constant (stream 4)
per_fault_type_column.F2 = IDV(2): Step - B composition, A/C ratio constant (stream 4)
per_fault_type_column.F8 = IDV(8): Random variation - A, B, C feed composition (stream 4)

subsets_S_F_proposal.status: PROPOSTA (decisione C) - discende dalla mappa sopra

trend.declared_limit: due sole classi: l'evidenza del bersaglio proviene interamente dal controllo e viceversa (§8.12)
